purpose: Cycle through overlapping preselection candidates at a fixed cursor position using calibrated navigation input.
trigger: Use when at least two candidates overlap at the known cursor position and candidate cycling is supported.

inputs.name: preselection_candidates
inputs.description: Known overlapping candidates at one fixed cursor location.

inputs.name: mouse_position
inputs.description: Fixed viewport position where candidates overlap.

inputs.name: navigation_mapping
inputs.description: Verified Ctrl+wheel mapping or a visible candidate-cycle equivalent.

preconditions: At least two overlapping candidates exist and fixed cursor position is known.
Controller exposes Ctrl+wheel or a deterministic candidate-cycle command.

outputs.name: preselection_state
outputs.description: Candidate order/identity before and after one cycle, cursor position, and control path.

postconditions: One cycle changes/identifies the preselection without moving the cursor or changing geometry.
Unsupported Ctrl+wheel is stopped or replaced by a recorded equivalent.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the window maximized/full-screen unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI observation/action; it must calibrate the current mapping and must not expand this atom into a view workflow. Combined Ctrl+wheel is explicitly capability-gated; no unverified direct automation is claimed.

ambiguity_checks: Resolve the declared target from its supplied identity and semantic properties; do not use arbitrary BodyN/FaceN aliases or return order.
If the target is not unique or the current topology/view cannot be observed, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; this operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared target, scope, or view identity is missing or ambiguous.
failure_modes.detection: The supplied identity does not resolve to exactly one current target.
failure_modes.safe_state: No validation action is performed and no pass claim is emitted.

failure_modes.condition: The required API, host path, controller gesture, or visible state cannot be observed.
failure_modes.detection: The adapter or controller reports unsupported/blocked/unknown state.
failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve the current document/view and return needs_manual_review or not_tested.

recovery.action: Strengthen the target identity or stop for manual review; do not substitute a numbered alias.
Use only a verified equivalent control/API or return needs_manual_review; do not repeat an unsupported gesture.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare its operation ID with the catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, candidate-only, and declares one independent validation_visual_review action.

validation.method: Compare this contract's inputs, outputs, procedure boundary, and refusal rules with the linked guidance file.
validation.expected: The contract exposes the same fields and preserves needs_manual_review, unsupported-control, and no-overclaim boundaries.

validation.method: Run the exact future script, host check, or calibrated controller action only after target identity and evidence gates pass.
validation.expected: One cycle changes/identifies the preselection without moving the cursor or changing geometry.

evidence_level.notes: Independent guidance application reviewed; structural host checks only. Unobserved variants remain not_tested.
